title: Micro-shift beacon for early usage/cost/latency regression detection with adaptive escalation
creator: Maya Patel
description: Implement a lightweight, low-noise 'micro-shift beacon' service in the console backend that detects subtle, early-stage regressions in per-tenant usage, cost, and latency signals. The beacon will run parallel to existing spike/guardrail detectors but focus on small distributional shifts (e.g., 5-15% change across several correlated metrics) that precede larger incidents or billing regressions. It must be low-cost, privacy-friendly, and integrated with staged escalation: silent pilot, internal ops digest, and then customer-facing alerting. Key features: probabilistic sub-sampling, feature hashing to limit cardinality, histogram-based baselining with decay windows, adaptive masking of noisy features, and SLO-exposure scoring to prioritize escalations.
acceptance_criteria: Beacon runs in prod on a 1-minute cadence for 10% sampled tenant traffic without exceeding a 5% CPU budget on console-backend nodes
Detects synthetic micro-shifts in test harness with >=90% precision and <=20% false positive rate when run against injected scenarios
Produces a prioritized digest (ranked by SLO exposure score) to the console ops dashboard and a separate Slack channel for silent pilot tenants
Includes autosnooze logic for deploy windows and account maintenance (configurable by project and by tenant)
Exposes explainability metadata (top contributing features, magnitude, historical baseline) in the alert payload and Console UI
All telemetry and interim datasets written comply with PII minimization: hashed tenant IDs, no raw prompt/response text retention
plan: Design: finalize detection algorithm and signal schema (histogram + summary stats) — deliverable: design doc link
Proto: implement a prototype beacon as a sidecar consumer in the usage pipeline (Kafka consumer) and validate with replay tests
Pilot: enable silent pilot for 50 tenants and wire digest to ops Slack + Grafana dashboard
Iterate: tune masking thresholds and scoring based on pilot feedback; add autosnooze windows and escalations
Rollout: enable for all tenants with opt-in/opt-out and expose controls in Console (alerts page)
implementation_notes: Schema: kafka.topic = telemetry.usage.summaries.v2; message is hashed_tenant_id + timestamp + metric_histograms + summary_stats
Storage: short-lived raw window in bigtable for 48h; aggregated baselines in timeseries-store (Prometheus histograms for dashboarding)
Dashboard: Grafana panel 'Beacon Digest' (grafana.company/board/beacon-digest), with links to tenant drilldowns
Runbook: ops/runbooks/beacon-detection.md created with triage steps and escalation matrix
risks: False positives for small tenants with sparse traffic — mitigated by exposure-weighted scoring and minimum-event thresholds
Resource cost if sampling is set too high — enforce 5-10% default sampling, circuit-breaker if CPU exceeds budget
Privacy leakage if un-hashed identifiers or text features slip into debug logs — require gated debug and automated scrubbers
Alert fatigue if digest is noisy — initial pilot will tune thresholds and the digest groups correlated shifts to reduce noise
